| **Kenmerk**               | **Synoniemen**               | **Definitie**                          | **Formule**                                                  |
|---------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Gevoeligheid (Sensitivity)** | True positive rate (TPR)     | $\pr{P | Z}$                           | $\frac{\text{TP}}{\text{TP} + \text{FN}}$                   |
| **Specificiteit (Specificity)** | True negative rate (TNR)    | $\pr{N | G}$                           | $\frac{\text{TN}}{\text{TN} + \text{FP}}$                   |
| **Positief Voorsp. Waarde (PPV)** | Predicted value positive  | $\pr{Z | P}$                           | $\frac{\text{TP}}{\text{TP} + \text{FP}}$                   |
| **Negatief Voorsp. Waarde (NPV)** | Predicted value negative  | $\pr{G | N}$                           | $\frac{\text{TN}}{\text{TN} + \text{FN}}$                   |
| **Foutpositief Percentage (FPR)** | Type I error rate         | $\pr{P | G}$                           | $\frac{\text{FP}}{\text{FP} + \text{TN}}$                   |
| **Foutnegatief Percentage (FNR)** | Type II error rate        | $\pr{N | Z}$                           | $\frac{\text{FN}}{\text{FN} + \text{TP}}$                   |
  | **Prevalentie**           | Disease prevalence          | $\pr{Z}$                               | $\frac{\text{TP} + \text{FN}}{\text{Totale populatie}}$      |
